claims.text: Some customers expressed interest, but fewer described a near-term use case.

sourceRefs.quote: 8 participants expressed interest in AI Analytics, but only 3 described a near-term use case they would actively deploy.

limitations: Fictional sample of 12 conversations; not validated market research.

claims.text: A limited pilot can be enabled for up to 10 accounts using feature flags.

claims.text: High-concurrency timeouts remain unresolved, and the incident owner advises against a broad launch until safeguards pass.

sourceRefs.quote: A recent analytics workload test produced timeout errors at high concurrency; root cause analysis remains open.
The incident owner recommends no broad launch until load tests and rollback procedures pass.

limitations: The root cause analysis is still open.

claims.text: Internal beta activation is an early signal, not proof of broad demand.

sourceRefs.quote: Feature activation in the fictional internal beta was 22% across 50 invited accounts. This is an early signal rather than evidence of general market demand.

limitations: No retention or willingness-to-pay results are available.

benefits: Reach the full customer base sooner.
risks: Unresolved high-concurrency timeouts could affect customers.
prerequisites: Pass load tests and establish rollback procedures.
assumptions: Reliability issues will be resolved before general availability.

benefits: Test a real use case with a small, controlled group.
risks: A small pilot may not represent enterprise demand or broader usage.
prerequisites: Limit eligibility to at most 10 accounts; monitor performance; define rollback and stop criteria.
assumptions: Feature flags can reliably contain the pilot.

benefits: Create time to resolve the incident and validate reliability.
risks: Delays learning from customer use and postpones potential value.
prerequisites: Complete load testing and rollback automation before reconsidering launch.
assumptions: The additional engineering work can be completed and re-evaluated.

rationale: A limited, monitored pilot is a conditional path to learn while containing exposure. Do not proceed to broad launch until the unresolved timeout issue is understood and load tests and rollback procedures pass. This is a reasonable option, not the only possible business decision.
missingEvidence: Retention and willingness-to-pay results are unavailable.
The estimated three engineering weeks for general availability have not been validated.
contradictions: Customer interest is present, but only a few conversations described near-term use; internal activation is an early signal, while reliability evidence argues against broad launch.
